results.title: U.S. ranks third in global protein security index
results.description: Most countries remain vulnerable to protein supply disruptions, according to the 2026 Protein Sovereignty Index released Oct. 16 by Full Circle Biotech, which ranked the United States third globally and Canada first.

results.title: Hawaii justices push state to help dysfunctional Elections Commission
results.description: Hawaii Supreme Court justices on Friday appeared perturbed with the State Office of Elections not trying to help a dysfunctional oversight commission meet during an ongoing elections season. The post Hawaii justices push state to help dysfunctional Elections Commission appeared first on The Garden Island.
